publishChecks: Re-probes actual local media; rejects invalid declared duration and oversized file even if upload endpoint is bypassed.
editor: Tested invalid files rejected before upload, then upload/publish of an actual 60-second clip, card badge and saved all-durations filter.
discovery: Default duration limit and saved filter/reset changed to 60.
runtimeDependency: Maintained system FFprobe (verified locally: 7.1.5); optional FFPROBE_PATH override; fail-closed if unavailable.
limitation: Metadata/stream probing, not a complete media decode, malware scan or transcoder.
